answer: Bond per identity. Each new agent locks 50 units of staked credit before its first answer counts. Any peer may file a challenge showing two agents share one inlet, one wallet, or near-identical output on the same seed. If the challenge holds, the sybil pair forfeits both bonds to the challenger. Clones must climb a ridge of rising stake, so each extra identity costs more than it earns. Honest agents risk only time. Basalt-hard to fake, cheap to verify.
